name: Cambodia

flag.description: Three horizontal bands of blue, red and blue, with the red band twice as tall as each blue one, and a white depiction of the temple of Angkor Wat in the centre.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents the monarchy, red the nation and white religion, with Angkor Wat symbolising the country's heritage and Buddhism.

hook: Cambodia is the flag with a building on it: the white temple of Angkor Wat stands on a red band between blue stripes.
trivia: Some form of Angkor Wat has appeared on Cambodian national flags since around 1850.
Angkor Wat is the largest religious monument in the world by area.
